subject: chemical_engineering

resources.title: Material and Energy Balances Resources
resources.notes: Verified collection with 225+ screencasts, self-study modules, simulations, spreadsheets, conceptual questions and digital experiments for material and energy balances. Beginner mapping reflects introductory engineering calculations and balance instruction; no foundation mapping is inferred.

resources.title: Thermodynamics 1 Resources
resources.notes: Verified introductory thermodynamics collection with screencasts, quizzes, self-study modules, simulations, spreadsheets and digital experiments covering energy, entropy, phase equilibrium and equations of state.

resources.title: Kinetics and Reactor Design Resources
resources.notes: Verified kinetics/reactor-design collection with introductory reactor-design material, 325+ screencasts, self-study modules, simulations, virtual laboratory work and assessment resources.

resources.title: Separations Resources
resources.notes: Verified separations/mass-transfer learning collection with 140+ screencasts, self-study modules, simulations, virtual laboratory material and digital experiments spanning distillation, absorption, extraction, membranes and diffusion.

resources.title: Process Control Resources
resources.notes: Verified process-control collection with introductory PID/feedforward/cascade control content, screencasts, quizzes, simulations and a distillation-control virtual laboratory.

resources.title: Process Design Screencasts
resources.notes: Verified process-design collection includes basics of block/process-flow/P&ID diagrams plus introductory Aspen Plus flowsheet, property-method and simulation tutorials.

resources.title: SAChE Certificate Program - Level One (Basic) Courses
resources.provider: AIChE Center for Chemical Process Safety
resources.notes: Provider describes this as the Level One Basic curriculum for students with little prior process-safety exposure, covering hazard recognition, risk, mitigation, lab safety and process-safety management fundamentals.

evidence_notes: Mappings are limited to levels explicitly supported by introductory/basic course positioning; resources are not promoted to foundation unless the provider explicitly presents foundational/basic instruction.
